steps.title: How to place the blanket
steps.lede: These steps are the book's own. It recommends at least 2 people to place the blanket, for safety.
list: Position the blanket in front of the vehicle at a distance that lets you act safely. Unroll the blanket so that it is centered.
Take the blanket by the handles at the ends and slide it over the car until it is completely covered. Always from the front of the vehicle toward the rear.
With your feet, push the excess blanket toward the underside of the vehicle until it is completely sealed. No air should get in under the vehicle.
Move away from the vehicle to a safe distance. Tires, windows and other parts could cause small explosions. Wait approximately 120 minutes until the fire is extinguished.
Carefully remove the blanket from the rear of the vehicle toward the front. Caution: the fire could flare up again.
